tasks.instruction: Bound grant-usage reporting while preserving its response contract. Aggregate daily, grant and lane usage without retaining the full event rowset. Accept at most 8192 distinct daily groups; exceeding that limit returns HTTP 422 with usage_range_too_large and no partial totals. Preserve inclusive since/until bounds, policy filtering, binary identifier ordering, null identities, token/cache counters and per-group totals. This repair is evaluated for functional bounds and correctness; it does not claim a measured process-memory improvement.

Preserve exact public-ID and physical-upstream model lookup. Before native opaque passthrough, match a native identity to a registered literal model card only when the complete public ID equals a declared provider model prefix plus that exact identity. Reject multiple matches. Do not infer aliases by suffix, case folding, trimming, URL decoding, or configured ${model}/${deployment} placeholders in either public or upstream IDs. The selected card still controls endpoint eligibility, metadata, pricing and allowlist policy; dispatch uses its declared physical upstream alias. Unmatched native IDs retain existing literal passthrough behavior without registered metadata or authority.

After validating a native OpenRouter music request, its returned response wrapper must retain only immutable scalar response context: the selected model and output format. It must not retain or reread ProxySelection, the prepared request, messages or request-body references during response parsing. Preserve the original destination/path, response ownership, MP3/WAV validation, streaming and error behavior. Later mutation of the caller request must not change response decoding.
